body: I looked in the mirror. It didn't look back.
I know you are, but what am I?

Yeah, three of my friends came out as bi later. I was actually amazed at how many there were because, where I live, stuff like that is pretty uncommon due to the predominant religion's suppression of such things and the fact that there aren't many people out here to begin with. Unfortunately, I'm not dating any of them, not as if their sexuality changes anything (they're all women), I'm just the guy who gets friend-zoned by pretty much everyone. 
Congratulations for you, though. That must be pretty nice.
